company_description_ko.source_text: Par Pacific Holdings, Inc., an energy company, provides renewable and conventional fuels in the United States. The company operates through three segments: Refining, Retail, and Logistics. The Refining segment owns and operates refineries that convert crude oil into gasoline, distillate, asphalt, and other products. The Retail segment operates convenience stores and fuel retail outlets that sell gasoline, diesel, and retail merchandise, such as soft drinks, prepared food, and other sundries under the Hele, 76, and nomnom brands, as well as unattended cardlock stations. limitations.text_ko: Adjusted Gross Margin — 조정 매출총이익은 변동성이 큰 원자재 가격의 총 영향을 제거하고 특정 비현금 항목 및 재고 금융 계약으로 인한 시점 차이와 순실현가능가치 조정 중 낮은 원가를 조정하여 투자자에게 유용한 정보를 제공한다. 이는 사업의 수익 잠재력을 보여주기 위함이다.

limitations.quote: We believe Adjusted Gross Margin (as defined below) provides useful information to investors because it eliminates the gross impact of volatile commodity prices and adjusts for certain non-cash items and timing differences created by our inventory financing agreements and lower of cost and net realizable value adjustments to demonstrate the earnings potential of the business before other fixed and variable costs, which are reported separately in Operating expense (excluding depreciation) and Depreciation and amortization.
